AGREEMENTOFPURCHASEANDSALEOFDEVELOPMENTRIGHTS LLC (the “Seller), a New York limited liability company, having an office at 42-57 27th Street, Long Island City, New York, and 27 HUNTER LLC (the “Purchaser"), a New York limited liability company, having an office c/o Jay Lau, Esq. 40 Cutter Mill Road, Suite 504, Great Neck, NewYork. WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Seller is the fee owner of a certain parcel of land,with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the Borough of Queens, City and State of New York, County of Queens, known as and by the street address 42-57 27th Street, Long Island City, New York and more particularly described in Exhibit A-1 annexed hereto and made a part of hereof and shown on the Tax Map of the City of NewYork as Block 431,Lot 30 (said land and tax lot beinghereinafter referred to as “Seller Land"; said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof being hereinafter referred to as the “Seller Building", and Seller Land and Seller Building being hereinafter referred to jointly as the “Seller Property"); WHEREAS, Purchaser is (i) the fee owner of certain parcels of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the Borough of Queens, City and State of New York, County of Queens,known as and by the street addresses 42-74& 42-76 Hunter Street and 42-53& 42-55 27th Street, Long Island City, New York and shown on the Tax Map of the City of New York as Block 431, Lots 6, 7, 27 and 28, more particularly described in Exhibit A-2 being referred to herein as “Purchaser Land"; said buildings and improvements on Purchaser Land, together with any future replacements thereof being hereinafter referred to as “Purchaser Building", and Purchaser's Land and Purchaser's Building being hereinafter referred to as “Purchaser Property"); WHEREAS,Purchaser desires to demolish or caused tobe demolished some or all of the existingbuildings located onPurchaser Land and may construct or cause tobe constructed thereon a new building or buildings (such building(s) being collectively referred to herein as the “New Building") having a“bulk” and “floor area" (both as defined in the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York, effective December 15,1961,as amended to date (the “Zoning Resolution")) in excess of the bulk and floor area presently permitted to be constructed on the Purchaser Land pursuant to the Zoning Resolution if Purchaser Land were to remain as an independent “zoning lot" (as defined in the Zoning Resolution); WHEREAS, there are Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) which are appurtenant to Seller Land, if Seller Land were considered as a separate and independent zoning lot, that are in excess of the Retained Development Rights (as hereinafter defined), which are available for transfer pursuant to the Zoning Resolution;.
